work_window_utc.meaning: Parallel source implementation, focused semantic review and inert checks; not runtime or acceptance performance.

implementation: Common preparation derives the exact worker byte count and digest from one source/mode/type-checked row in the full pinned common stage report and joins its static manifest pin.

The worker deployment artifact combines that real stage pair with actual worker-binding writer bytes. There is no public worker override, fabricated predecessor artifact or frozen validator/global mutation.
A local common provisioning validator preserves the frozen seven-writer semantic obligations while reusing existing pure canonical parsing, digest and artifact primitives.
Existing retained-CAS reconstruction replays the same preparation API, rejecting stale or rehashed historical worker artifacts. No second replay framework is introduced.
The exact common73 stage pin, current worker payload, public preparation APIs, source inventories and qualification ceilings remain unchanged.
review_findings_resolved: The frozen plugin-update validator hardcodes historical worker bytes independently of the full common stage pin. A real future worker could not pass honestly; common preparation now owns its stage-derived worker validation.

Independent review and a normalised AST comparison verified the same document inventories, configuration pin, policy/profile/grant/genesis checks, digest bounds and cross-document obligations. The only changed frozen semantic expression is the worker artifact pair.

Nine focused methods cover an unpatched actual current stage, explicitly inert reviewed future-worker data, static/artifact mismatches, retained reconstruction and rehashed historical-worker replacement refusal; no historical test discovery.

reviewed_input_closure.meaning: Previously reviewed common preparation closure plus the new test: transitive Python imports, inert stager source/payload inputs and fixed baseline/configuration data. Local AST import closure has no missing files; historical test methods are not discovered. Runner, interpreter/platform, requirements and prerequisite fingerprint are separately bound.

limitations: This change removes a preparation incompatibility; it does not instrument or install a new worker, invoke a service, publish a request, run a workload, observe clocks or prove runtime behavior.
Future-worker test records are explicitly inert and patch only the complete reviewed stage pin inside test scope. They are not deployable worker artifacts or replacement acceptance samples.
Full-profile and installed-source inventory migration still requires its own reviewed successor. The current common73 stage report and frozen predecessor sources remain unchanged.

Actual authenticated ingress, effective decision, independent sink/attribution and concrete callback wiring remain incomplete. Final31 and100-attempt/100-pair acceptance remains blocked, along with remaining admission and RUN/sensor implementation.
next_dependency: Implement the actual authenticated non-receipt frame ingress hook, held attempt and forwarded action joins in a separate private worker evidence directory. Use a permanent startup claim, immutable records and fatal retention failure; preserve receipt-store inventory and one-shot relay semantics. Introduce a reviewed worker/helper/unit/activator successor, update exact stage and installed-source inventories, and join one-collector clock-domain observations through the independent consumer before real prepared-attempt execution.
checkpoint_commit: Create one signed local commit, verify signature and clean tree, and retain its hash in ignored .aragorn/phase3-batch-<short-hash>-checkpoint.json. No automatic push.
